label: first two copy steps of long sequences (L>=8)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original tokens or the <DEL> step. Concentrated on the first two copy steps (recall_idx 1-2, input = orig(0) then orig(1)), which together carry about 89% of activation mass; recall_idx 1 is strongest (58% of mass, 30% firing rate), and the first copy step usually has the largest activation in a sequence. Rate rises steeply with sequence length (none for L<=4, 65% of mass from L=9), so it behaves like a counter of outputs still to go (to_go 5-7). A smaller secondary bump appears on the last copy steps of L=9 sequences. Magnitude depends on the token fed back as input: j, k, z, c, p give the largest activations (top examples all start with j or k). Precision is limited because many long sequences with other first tokens do not fire, and some activity at L=7 and late steps is missed. Dev F1 0.66, mass recall 0.81.
